subject: CloudArc vendor onboarding: DPA, SOC2, subprocessor list + PO routing
messages:
From: Sophie Turner <sophie.turner@cloudarc.com>
To: michael_grant@redwood.ai
Cc: CloudArc Procurement <procurement@cloudarc.com>
Date: Fri, 04 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: CloudArc onboarding packet and PO next steps

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the kick-off earlier this week — excited to get Redwood live on CloudArc. Per our checklist from procurement, please find the onboarding bundle attached and links below:

- Executed DPA (signed via DocuSign) — attached and also available here: https://app.docusign.com/documents/execDPA-CloudArc-2026
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted) — attached and shared via Drive: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SOC2ExampleLink/view?usp=sharing
- Current subprocessor roster (CSV) — attached as subprocessors_2026-09.csv
- Standard invoice template and W-9 — attached

We store production logs for 30 days and use AES-256 at rest with customer data keys managed in AWS KMS. Our security contact is security@cloudarc.com if your InfoSec team has follow-ups.

For PO/invoice routing, please confirm the exact legal entity name to appear on the PO and the remit-to address. Once we have PO instructions, we can accept an electronic PO or a contract reference number for billing. Typical fields you might provide: legal name, tax ID, billing address, billing contact name/email, and desired invoice cadence (monthly/quarterly).

Let us know if you want us to resend any items in a different format or if your procurement needs additional attestations.

Attachments: CloudArc_Executed_DPA_20260904.pdf, SOC2_TypeII_2026_Redacted.pdf, subprocessors_2026-09.csv, CloudArc_W9_and_invoice_template.pdf

Best,
Sophie Turner
Head of Customer Success, CloudArc
sophie.turner@cloudarc.com
(415) 555-0182

Subject: Re: CloudArc onboarding packet and PO next steps

Hi Sophie — thanks for the packet and quick turnaround. A couple of clarifying asks from procurement and legal so we can route the PO this week: 

1) The attached DPA appears executed — can you confirm the signer and the execution date (and point us to the DocuSign audit trail if available)?
2) The SOC2 file is helpful — for our compliance team can you confirm whether the redaction removed customer-specific examples only (preferred) and share an executive summary page we can include with the PO packet?
3) Subprocessor CSV looks good at a glance; procurement will ingest that into our registry. Please include a short description column for any subprocessors that process PERSONAL DATA.
4) Billing/legal: please confirm the legal entity name for invoicing, the remit-to address, tax ID (TIN/EIN), and preferred invoice email. Also confirm whether you accept Redwood's standard PO (we typically route via Oracle NetSuite).

We are aiming to finalize the PO by next Tues (2026-09-07) to hit our internal go-live target of 2026-10-01. Looping in Laura (procurement) and Karthik (legal ops) to pick up PO routing and contract questions.

If it's easier, feel free to send the DocuSign link for the executed DPA and a short note on the subprocessor descriptions.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
michael_grant@redwood.ai
